question: Which para-swimmer received the Arjuna Award (Lifetime) in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Murlikant Petkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Murlikant Petkar** is a celebrated para-swimmer and was the first Indian to win a **Paralympic gold medal**. He achieved this feat at the **1972 Heidelberg Paralympics** in the 50m freestyle swimming event.
 
• He set a **world record** during the 1972 Paralympics by clocking a time of 37.33 seconds in his event.
 
• Before his para-sports career, Petkar served in the **Indian Army** but was injured during the **1965 Indo-Pak war**, leading to his disability.
 
• He transitioned to para-sports and excelled not only in swimming but also in other sports like wheelchair racing and javelin throw, showcasing his versatility.
